title: KVCOMM: Online Cross-context KV-cache Communication for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
authors: Hancheng Ye; Zhengqi Gao; Mingyuan Ma; Qinsi Wang; Yuzhe Fu; Ming-Yu Chung; Yueqian Lin; Zhijian Liu; Jianyi Zhang; Danyang Zhuo; Yiran Chen
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: In multi-agent LLM systems agents share large overlapping context (system prompt, documents, peer messages), but each agent prepends a DIFFERENT agent-specific prefix, so the same shared content yields different KV tensors (offset variance) and standard prefix/exact-match KV reuse fails — forcing redundant re-prefill and high TTFT.
problem_statement.zh: 在多 agent LLM 系統中,各 agent 共享大量重疊 context(system prompt、文件、peer 訊息),但每個 agent 會前置不同的 agent 專屬 prefix,使得相同的共享內容產生不同的 KV tensor(offset variance),標準的 prefix/精確比對 KV reuse 因而失效,被迫重複 prefill 並推高 TTFT。

key_innovation.en: A training-free online cross-agent KV-cache communication framework. Each agent keeps a 'base KV-cache' for shared content (no external prefix); an online-updated 'anchor pool' stores observed cache offsets (deviations) under varying prefixes. For a new request it reuses ALL shared-content KV and corrects it via an anchor-weighted offset estimate, (k/v)_hat = (k/v) + sum_i w_i * Delta(k/v)_i, with RoPE-aware de-rotation/re-rotation so keys align before the offset is applied. Three modules: Anchor Matching (nearest anchors per segment), Offset Approximation (weighted deviation), Anchor Prediction (whether new KV becomes a shared anchor). Built on two empirical regularities — KV proximity (nearby-embedding tokens have nearby KV) and offset proximity (similar tokens share similar offsets under the same prefix change). Notably it REUSES all shared KV + adds offsets and explicitly does NOT do CacheBlend-style selective recompute (falling back to dense prefill on anchor miss).
key_innovation.zh: 一個免訓練的線上跨 agent KV-cache 通訊框架。每個 agent 為共享內容保留一份『base KV-cache』(不含外部 prefix);線上更新的『anchor pool』記錄不同 prefix 下觀察到的 cache 偏移量(deviation)。面對新請求時,它重用全部共享內容的 KV,並以 anchor 加權的偏移估計修正:(k/v)_hat = (k/v) + sum_i w_i * Delta(k/v)_i,並進行 RoPE-aware 的 de-rotate/re-rotate 使 key 對齊後再加偏移。三個模組:Anchor Matching(為每段找最近的 anchor)、Offset Approximation(加權偏移)、Anchor Prediction(判斷新產生的 KV 是否成為共享 anchor)。其立基於兩個經驗規律 —— KV proximity(embedding 相近的 token KV 也相近)與 offset proximity(相同 prefix 變化下相似 token 的偏移亦相近)。值得注意的是它重用全部共享 KV 並加偏移,明確不採用 CacheBlend 式的 selective recompute(anchor 未命中時退回 dense prefill)。

baselines_compared: Dense prefill (no reuse), Full KV reuse, CacheBlend

key_improvements.en: Over 70% KV reuse across RAG, math-reasoning, and collaborative-coding multi-agent workloads with no quality degradation. Up to 7.8x prefill speedup (TTFT ~430ms -> ~55ms) for a 5-agent fully-connected setting (1K input, 512 prefix, 512 output tokens), 6.7x average prefill speedup, on a single H100; accuracy drop < 2.5%.
key_improvements.zh: 在 RAG、數學推理與協作 coding 等多 agent 工作負載下達成超過 70% 的 KV reuse 且品質無損。在 5-agent 全連接設定(1K 輸入、512 prefix、512 輸出 token)下 prefill 最高加速 7.8x(TTFT 從約 430ms 降至約 55ms)、平均 prefill 加速 6.7x(單張 H100);精度損失低於 2.5%。
